text:
Mandarmoni is a seaside resort village in the state of West Bengal, India, and lies in East Midnapore district, at the northern end of the Bay of Bengal. It is one of the largest seaside resorts of West Bengal, fast-developing.

--- Practical Travel Context (Wikivoyage) ---
Purba Medinipur or East Midnapore (পূর্ব মেদিনীপুর Pūrbo Medinīpur) is a coastal district of West Bengal. It was once a part of Midnapore district until 2003, which got split into two districts: Paschim Medinipur and Purba Medinipur.
best_time: October to March (pleasant weather, ideal for heritage monuments, wildlife, and cultural walks)
